title: File Architecture Decision Records for all major design choices
description:
Create docs/adr/ directory. File ADRs (Markdown, Nygard format) for: (1) ed25519 signing library choice, (2) IPFS client library choice (from spike), (3) SQLite over Postgres for local state, (4) gossipsub per-hierarchy vs per-group, (5) synthetic article numbers vs global stable IDs, (6) Merkle-CRDT vs operational transform for group log. Artifact: docs/adr/0001-*.md through 0006-*.md.

Acceptance criteria: each ADR has: status, context, decision, consequences; ADR-0002 references spike benchmark results
